title: 第七回 灵婆摘心第八回 慕府联姻
slug: 驭音心经第七十回狼心逞乱
lines: 第七回灵婆摘心
“把浴桶搬进来。”
灵婆吩咐她儿子，搬来一个热气腾腾的浴桶。
“你打算怎么做，母亲？”
灵婆儿子低声询问，言语间难掩那份跃跃欲试的激动。
“先取灵卷，再吃人。”
灵婆道。
原来，这灵婆母子乃一对修炼千年的妖狐，灵婆居于天台山顶，连续三夜，望见山顶有极光奇景，她料知此必为仙人所为，有仙人路过或是到此云游，于是，她便穿过林间，怀揣好奇与期许，躲在巨石后查看，果见两个仙子在此歌舞。
一位仙子身上落下一物，那物落于地上，璀璨闪光，灵婆知道此乃千载难逢的机缘，便飞奔过去，叼走那物，一口囫囵吞下，自此得了一些灵气。
但灵婆不知的是，她所吞那物，乃仙子所用巾环。
妖狐虽是由此得了灵气，幻化出人形，但却因巾环卡在体内，无法消解，如同一块顽石，折磨的她日渐消瘦。
妖狐灵修受阻，于是便心生邪念，决定食人取灵，以弥补己身亏损，她带儿子迁居至此，以灵婆自居，诱人前来通灵，伺机食人取灵。
可是，二人怎么掰，却也掰不开孤鹤雁紧攥的手指，灵婆儿子便问：“怎么办，母亲？”
灵婆眼中闪过一丝不耐，索性道：“先把他放进浴桶松弛，实在不行，我们就直接斩了他。”
灵婆儿子闻听，便动手去剥孤鹤雁衣服。
灵婆突然眼神一凝，喝止儿子。
“怎么了？”
灵婆儿子惊问。
“你容我再看看。”
灵婆说话的声音带着一丝异样的颤抖与激动。
原来，灵婆儿子将孤鹤雁的上衣脱下，突现孤鹤雁那颗外突的心，灵婆得见，如见灵幻，惊讶稀罕，遂出声喝止。
灵婆走过去仔细瞧看，语气中透着一股难以置信：“这孩子的心脏，何以如此奇特？”
“难道他……，不是个凡种？”
“你先放下他，容我再看看。”
灵婆沉声道。
灵婆儿子依言将孤鹤雁轻放在祭台上。
灵婆缓缓给自己裹上头巾，双手合十，闭上眼睛，口中不断念念有词，片刻后，她猛然睁开双眼，眼中精光四射，仿佛能洞穿一切，她缓缓站起身，走向孤鹤雁，神情凝重。
“怎么了，母亲，你看见什么异常了吗？”
灵婆儿子问。
“我看到一朵莲花。”
灵婆缓缓道，声音中带着一丝激动。
“在哪里？”
灵婆儿子问。
“在这孩子的心里。”
灵婆用她枯瘦的手指一指孤鹤雁那颗外突的心。
“我还看到，在那朵莲花四周，金光四溢，金光背后，隐有灵兽，这个肉身，怕不是个凡体！”

Chapter 7: Lingpo's topping
"Bring the bathtub in."
Lingpo ordered her son to bring a steaming bathtub.
"What are you going to do, mother?"
Lingpo's son asked in a low voice, unable to conceal his eagerness to try in his words.
"First take the spirit scroll, then eat the people."
Ling Po said.
It turned out that the mother-in-law and her son were a pair of demon foxes who had been cultivating for thousands of years. The spirit-in-law lived on the top of the Tiantai Mountain. For three consecutive nights, she saw the aurora at the top of the mountain. She expected that this must be the work of an immortal. An immortal was passing by or wandering here. So, she walked through the forest, full of curiosity and expectation, hid behind the boulder to check, and saw two fairies singing and dancing here.
An object fell on a fairy's body. The object fell to the ground and shone brightly. The spirit woman knew that this was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, so she rushed over, took the object in her mouth, swallowed it whole, and gained some spiritual energy from then on.
But what the spirit woman didn't know was that the thing she swallowed was the scarf ring used by fairies.
Although the demon fox gained spiritual energy from this and transformed into a human form, the scarf ring was stuck in her body and could not be dispelled, like a stubborn stone, which tortured her and made her lose weight day by day.
The demon fox's spiritual cultivation was hindered, so she had evil thoughts in her heart and decided to eat people and take souls to make up for her losses. She moved here with her son, claiming to be a spiritual woman, tempting people to come to channel, and waiting for the opportunity to cannibalize people and take spirits.
However, no matter how they broke up, they couldn't break Gu Heyan's tightly clenched fingers, so Lingpo's son asked: "What should I do, mother?"
A trace of impatience flashed in Ling Po's eyes, and she simply said: "Put him in the bathtub to relax first. If that doesn't work, we will just kill him."
After Lingpo's son heard this, he started to peel off Gu Heyan's clothes.
"Stop!"
Ling Po's eyes suddenly narrowed and she stopped her son.
"What's wrong?"
Lingpo's son asked in surprise.
"Let me take another look."
Ling Po's voice was filled with a strange trembling and excitement.
It turned out that Lingpo's son took off Gu Heyan's shirt, revealing Gu Heyan's protruding heart. When Lingpo saw it, she was astonished as if she saw a ghost, and she shouted to stop.
Lingpo walked over and took a closer look, with a hint of disbelief in her tone: "Why is this child's heart so strange?"
"Is he...not a mortal?"
"Put him down first and let me take a look."
Lingpo said in a deep voice.
Lingpo's son followed the instructions and placed Guheyan gently on the altar.
Lingpo slowly wrapped a scarf on herself, clasped her hands together, closed her eyes, and kept mumbling words. After a moment, she suddenly opened her eyes, her eyes gleaming with light, as if she could penetrate everything. She stood up slowly and walked towards Lone Heyan with a solemn expression.
"What's wrong, mother, did you see anything abnormal?"
Lingpo's son asked.
"I saw a lotus flower."
Ling Po said slowly, with a hint of excitement in her voice.
"Where?"
Lingpo's son asked.
"In this kid's heart."
Ling Po pointed at Lone Heyan's protruding heart with her skinny finger.
"I also saw that around the lotus, golden light overflowed. Behind the golden light, there was a spiritual beast hidden. This physical body is probably not a mortal body!"
title_en: Chapter 7: Lingpo’s heart-picking Chapter 8: Marriage in Mu Mansion
